_說明: 測試用「燈光 look」：由 lighting/capture_demo_show.mvr 嘅燈位出發，每個檔寫入每支燈嘅顏色（Color，CIE xyY）同亮度（Dimmer）。MVR 只存一個靜態畫面，所以一個 look 一個檔；cue 順序唔喺 MVR 入面。gradient＝沿舞台左右（x）漸變，stops 可以多過兩個。

looks.title: Capture look · Verse (cool blue)
looks.note: Test look: dim blue wash, blue-to-violet backlight, follow spots off.

looks.title: Capture look · Chorus (warm)
looks.note: Test look: amber wash, magenta-to-orange backlight, warm follow spots.

looks.title: Capture look · Solo (follow spots)
looks.note: Test look: stage nearly dark, follow spots at full.

looks.title: Capture look · Finale (colour sweep)
looks.note: Test look: every light takes a colour from its left-right position.
